title: Smoother distant plants and a much lighter 1904 flight on phones
items: The distant grasses and plants are now laid out by the graphics card instead of the processor, so walking, turning and flying stutter less.
Flying over 1904 Prairie Avenue asks a phone for about a tenth of the drawing work it did, because each house's pieces are now drawn together.
Nothing in the scene looks different: the same plants stand in the same places, and every building draws exactly as before.
